title: Monk
text:
My life has been naught but discipline and focus, preparing me for this. I fight for the Benevolent Dreamer. Free my hands, and those who seek chaos will fall before me!
The Monk is a dexterity/intelligence-oriented class that specializes in unarmed and quarterstaff skills.

Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.Converts 60% of Physical damage to Lightning damageCone length is 4 metres  Additional Effects From 1-20% Quality:  (1-20)% more Damage per Power Charge ConsumedSkills can be managed in the Skills Panel. as his default starting weapon and skill in The Riverbank.


== Ascendancy classes ==
Monks can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:

Invoker
Acolyte of Chayula
Martial Artist


== Lore ==
The Monk is a member of the Keepers of the Flame, a monastic cult dedicated to the worship of the being known as the Dreamer with a mission to stop the Hiveborn from invading Wraeclast.
Years before, plagued by dreams that cast doubt on the Dreamer, the Monk had left the Monastery to better understand his faith.
The Monk himself is of Ezomyte heritage.


== Dialogues ==


=== Entering locations ===


==== Act 1 ====
The Riverbank: By the Dreamer's will, I have another chance.
Clearfell Encampment: How have the Ezomytes fallen this far?
Clearfell: —
Mud Burrow: A foul lair, for a foul creature.
The Grelwood: I have dreamt of this place as of late... I am called forward.
The Red Vale: Generations of senseless conflict. And for what?
The Grim Tangle: I won't be getting through here... for now.
Cemetery of the Eternals: This land is haunted by its past...
Mausoleum of the Praetor: This place harbours an everlasting malice.
Tomb of the Consort: Somewhere in the darkness, a soul lies dreaming of hate...
Hunting Grounds: Finally, familiar terrain. I must be getting close to their village...
Freythorn: I sense... a surreal presence...
Ogham Farmlands: —
Ogham Village: What is this madness?! I fear I am too late.
The Manor Ramparts: Madness echoes here.
Ogham Manor: The walls carry a subtle beat of a monstrous heart.


==== Act 2 ====
Vastiri Outskirts: So, these are the Maraketh. Life seems difficult in the desert.
The Ardura Caravan: So this is how they survive..
Mawdun Quarry: This great wound in the land bodes ill.
Mawdun Mine: They died clawing for escape. This place is a tomb.
The Halani Gates (1): Why has the caravan stopped?
Traitor's Passage:
The Halani Gates (2): Let us see what the Faridun have in store for me.
Mastodon Badlands: Death shelters life in an unforgiving land.
The Bone Pits: A wasteland without end.
Keth: Aspirations of an ancient civilisation still resonate from this place.
The Lost City: They put their faith in the wrong gods. This place is a testament to their choice.
Buried Shrines: Something emanates from the darkness...
Valley of the Titans: This is no place for mortals.
The Titan Grotto: The Third Pact speaks of this! I'm not supposed to be here...
Deshar: I didn't expect burial spires to be so beautiful.
Path of Mourning: Mankind always aspires to reach the skies, even in death.
The Spires of Deshar: —
The Dreadnought: We fight to the end!
Dreadnought Vanguard: The Beast is close. The very air rots on the wind.
Trial of the Sekhemas: Here, mettle was tested. Here, I shall surpass.


==== Act 3 ====
Sandswept Marsh: Where the Dreamer wills, I go.
Ziggurat Encampment: I recognise this place from my dreams...
Jungle Ruins: They swing among the trees...
The Venom Crypts: Darkness and decay...
Infested Barrens: Wraeclast is adorned with the scars of what once was.
The Azak Bog: This stench is damaging my calm.
Chimeral Wetlands: What wondrous sights!
Jiquani's Machinarium: That statue... how ominous...
Jiquani's Sanctum: How strange. I should ask Alva about this.
The Matlan Waterways: They're here, just as Servi warned.
The Drowned City: This city is not dead... something moves in hidden spaces...
Apex of Filth: Foul spores cloy the wind.
The Molten Vault: What horrors does this quiet darkness hide?
Temple of Kopec: What is the source of that blinding light?
Utzaal: Utzaal... lives!
Aggorat: Such beauty... such violence.
The Black Chambers: —
The Ziggurat Refuge: Uhh... How long have I been asleep?
The Temple of Chaos: Another chance to test my mettle.


==== Act 4 ====
Singing Caverns: That melody hides teeth... yet it beckons me.
Solitary Confinement: The Eternals left these prisoners to drown... Is there no limit to their cruelty?
Journey's End: The fog off this shore is thicker still. I must not lose my way.
Plunder's Point: So this is where the map leads...
Eye of Hinekora: A place steeped in tradition. I must be respectful.
Halls of the Dead: I walk step where few outsiders have tread.
Arastas: Kindness is a rare thing in Wraeclast. I hope it’s no mirage.
The Excavation: The scale of this excavation... Perhaps the Order have found something of use.
Heart of the Tribe: All this blood... on Tavakai’s hands. This has to end.


=== Boss defeated ===


==== Act 1 ====
The Bloated Miller: Skill always beats raw strength.
Beira of the Rotten Pack: —
The Devourer: Nightmares have no power against the light.
The Brambleghast: I best not tarry... if the trees here can behave like that...
The Rust King: Sleep now, and dream no longer!
The Rotten Druid: Begone, foul creature!
Draven, the Eternal Praetor: Let the Ezomytes buried here finally know peace.
Asinia, the Praetor's Consort: Forbidden thaumaturgy causes nothing but pain and misery.
Lachlann of Endless Lament: Rejoin your family, tortured soul.
The Crowbell: Corruption creates strange beasts indeed.
The King in the Mists: Better dead than enslaved to a false religion.
The Executioner: Mere strength is no match for skill.
Candlemass, the Living Rite: This is the cost of pagan beliefs.
Count Geonor: The Dreamer will not take your soul to unity, Geonor. Rot here for all time.


==== Act 2 ====
Rathbreaker: Let this prove my worth. I should return to the caravan.
Rudja, the Dread Engineer: At least there's one survivor of this madness.
Balbala, the Traitor: A coin...?
Jamanra, the Risen King: I have seen the face of the enemy, and it is hatred.
Ekbab, Ancient Steed: Death reclaims its own.
Kabala, Constrictor Queen: I won't soon forget this one... eugh.
Azarian, the Forsaken Son: —
Zalmarath, the Colossus: A servant of the Dreamer has dared... and succeeded!
Tor Gul, the Defiler: Is it the Beast that empowers such horrors? This must end!
Jamanra, the Abomination: Asala!


==== Act 3 ====
Rootdredge: This land is infested with ancient Corruption!
Mighty Silverfist: Man bests beast once again!
Ignagduk, the Bog Witch: I have had my fill of witches for one lifetime.
Xyclucian, the Chimeral: —
Blackjaw, the Remnant: That thing, it fought with the ire of a mortal man...
Zicoatl, Warden of the Core: Finally, I have what I need.
Mektul, the Forgemaster: The dangers of wealth have never been so literal.
The Queen of Filth: You were not even worthy of my skills.
Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun: Endless power... corrupts.
Viper Napuatzi: What... where did she go?
Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge: —


==== Act 4 ====
Krutog, Lord of Kin: You wrought death and ruin. Now it calls you home.
Scourge of the Skies: No more will you darken the skies.
The Prisoner: Long have you suffered. May rest find you now.
Captain Hartlin: Your curse does not bind me!


==== Other ====
The Ninth Treasure of Keth: Wealth is useless in a dead empire.
Rattlecage, the Earthbreaker: Discipline and strength triumph once again.


=== Level up ===
Reaching level 2: My training continues.
Reaching level 3: Each victory is but another milestone on the endless path.
Reaching level 5: Savor the feeling, but keep moving forward.
Reaching level 10: The Dreamer guides.
Reaching level 15: Today is a good day!
Reaching level 20: Enlightening!
Reaching level 30: Fate is on my side this day!
Reaching level 40: Mastery is within my grasp!
Reaching level 50: A noteworthy attainment!
Reaching level 60: The zenith of my power so far!
Reaching level 70: My journey continues!
Reaching level 80: Elevation!
Reaching level 90: Dreamer! Bear witness!
Reaching level 100:
I have reached the limits of the mortal form!
Ultimate discipline!
I am the master now!


=== Miscellaneous ===


==== Full inventory ====
I carry few possessions. And I don't have room for that.
I must maintain a fine balance.
I've no room for that.
I have no room for that.


==== Using ability in town ====
This isn't the place. Or the time.
That would draw unwanted attention.
I must restrain myself.


==== Using well ====
Relief.
A cool drink.
A moment's respite.
Ahh.... a moment's respite.


==== Respec passive point ====
I must meditate.
Time to refocus.
Let's try something different.


==== Other ====
Choice of an Ascendancy class: My path diverges.
Selecting Acolyte of Chayula Ascendancy class: The power of the Dreamer flows through me!
